title: Is Creatine Actually Bad For You? Here's What the Research Says
description: Hair loss, kidney damage, bloating, cramps: the creatine scare list is long and mostly built on one small study and a lot of gym myth. Here's what the trials and meta-analyses really found, plus a safe daily dose. #creatine #creatinemonohydrate #supplements #gymscience #musclebuilding #fuelnfithub
